<h1 id="twilio---api-api20100401account">Api20100401Account</h1>

## Retrieves a collection of Accounts belonging to the account used to make the request

<a id="opIdListAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts.json`

Retrieves a collection of Accounts belonging to the account used to make the request

<h3 id="retrieves-a-collection-of-accounts-belonging-to-the-account-used-to-make-the-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|FriendlyName|query|string|false|Only return the Account resources with friendly names that exactly match this name.|
|Status|query|[account_enum_status](#schemaaccount_enum_status)|false|Only return Account resources with the given status. Can be `closed`, `suspended` or `active`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Status|active|
|Status|suspended|
|Status|closed|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "first_page_uri": "/2010-04-01/Accounts.json?FriendlyName=friendly_name&Status=active&PageSize=50&Page=0",
  "end": 0,
  "previous_page_uri": null,
  "accounts": [],
  "uri": "/2010-04-01/Accounts.json?FriendlyName=friendly_name&Status=active&PageSize=50&Page=0",
  "page_size": 50,
  "start": 0,
  "next_page_uri": null,
  "page": 0
}
```

<h3 id="retrieves-a-collection-of-accounts-belonging-to-the-account-used-to-make-the-request-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|

<h3 id="retrieves-a-collection-of-accounts-belonging-to-the-account-used-to-make-the-request-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|end|integer|false|none|none|
|first_page_uri|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|next_page_uri|string(uri) \| null|false|none|none|
|page|integer|false|none|none|
|page_size|integer|false|none|none|
|previous_page_uri|string(uri) \| null|false|none|none|
|start|integer|false|none|none|
|uri|string(uri)|false|none|none|
|accounts|[[api.v2010.account](#schemaapi.v2010.account)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||Specify the origin(s) allowed to access the resource|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Methods|string||Specify the HTTP methods allowed when accessing the resource|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Headers|string||Specify the headers allowed when accessing the resource|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Credentials|boolean||Indicates whether the browser should include credentials|
|200|Access-Control-Expose-Headers|string||Headers exposed to the client|

## Create a new Twilio Subaccount from the account making the request

<a id="opIdCreateAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'FriendlyName=friendly_name'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts.json`

Create a new Twilio Subaccount from the account making the request

> Body parameter

```yaml
FriendlyName: friendly_name
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-twilio-subaccount-from-the-account-making-the-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» FriendlyName|body|string|false|A human readable description of the account to create, defaults to `SubAccount Created at {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM meridian}`|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "auth_token": "auth_token",
  "date_created": "Thu, 30 Jul 2015 20:00:00 +0000",
  "date_updated": "Thu, 30 Jul 2015 20:00:00 +0000",
  "friendly_name": "friendly_name",
  "owner_account_sid": "ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "sid": "ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "status": "active",
  "subresource_uris": {
    "available_phone_numbers": "/2010-04-01/Accounts/ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/AvailablePhoneNumbers.json",

    "signing_keys": "/2010-04-01/Accounts/ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/SigningKeys.json",
```

## Modify the properties of a given Account

<a id="opIdUpdateAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'FriendlyName=friendly_name&Status=active'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{Sid}.json`

Modify the properties of a given Account

> Body parameter

```yaml
FriendlyName: friendly_name
Status: active
```

<h3 id="modify-the-properties-of-a-given-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Sid|path|string|true|The Account Sid that uniquely identifies the account to update|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» FriendlyName|body|string|false|Update the human-readable description of this Account|
|» Status|body|[account_enum_status](#schemaaccount_enum_status)|false|The status of this account. Usually `active`, but can be `suspended` or `closed`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» Status|active|
|» Status|suspended|
|» Status|closed|

<h1 id="twilio---api-api20100401call">Api20100401Call</h1>

## Retrieves a collection of calls made to and from your account

<a id="opIdListCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls.json`

Retrieves a collection of calls made to and from your account

<h3 id="retrieves-a-collection-of-calls-made-to-and-from-your-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Call resource(s) to read.|
|To|query|string(phone-number)|false|Only show calls made to this phone number, SIP address, Client identifier or SIM SID.|
|From|query|string(phone-number)|false|Only include calls from this phone number, SIP address, Client identifier or SIM SID.|
|ParentCallSid|query|string|false|Only include calls spawned by calls with this SID.|
|Status|query|[call_enum_status](#schemacall_enum_status)|false|The status of the calls to include. Can be: `queued`, `ringing`, `in-progress`, `canceled`, `completed`, `failed`, `busy`, or `no-answer`.|
|StartTime|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that started on this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started on this date.|
|StartTime<|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that started before this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started before this date.|
|StartTime>|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that started on or after this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that started on or after this date.|
|EndTime|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that ended on this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended on this date.|
|EndTime<|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that ended before this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended before this date.|
|EndTime>|query|string(date-time)|false|Only include calls that ended on or after this date. Specify a date as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC, for example: `2009-07-06`, to read only calls that ended on or after this date.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Status|queued|
|Status|ringing|
|Status|in-progress|
|Status|completed|
|Status|busy|
|Status|failed|
|Status|no-answer|
|Status|canceled|

## Create a new outgoing call to phones, SIP-enabled endpoints or Twilio Client connections

<a id="opIdCreateCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'ApplicationSid=APaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa&FallbackMethod=GET&FallbackUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&From=%2B987654321&IfMachine=if_machine&MachineDetection=enable&MachineDetectionTimeout=15&Method=GET&Record=true&RecordingTrack=both&Trim=do-not-trim&SendDigits=send_digits&StatusCallback=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&StatusCallbackMethod=GET&Timeout=1&To=%2B123456789&Url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&CallerId=Caller&MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold=3000&MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold=3000&MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout=3000&AsyncAmd=true&AsyncAmdStatusCallback=http%3A%2F%2Fstatuscallback.com&AsyncAmdStatusCallbackMethod=POST&MachineDetectionEngine=Lumenvox&MachineDetectionMinWordLength=100&MachineDetectionMaxWordLength=5000&MachineDetectionWordsSilence=50&MachineDetectionMaxNumOfWords=5&MachineDetectionSilenceThreshold=256&Byoc=BYaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa&CallReason=Reason%20for%20the%20call%20(Beta)&TimeLimit=3600&CallToken=call-token-string&Transcribe=true&TranscriptionConfiguration=JVaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa&ClientNotificationUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fclientnotification.com'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls.json`

Create a new outgoing call to phones, SIP-enabled endpoints or Twilio Client connections

> Body parameter

```yaml
ApplicationSid: APaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
FallbackMethod: GET
FallbackUrl: "https://example.com"
From: "+987654321"
IfMachine: if_machine
MachineDetection: enable
MachineDetectionTimeout: 15
Method: GET
Record: "true"
RecordingTrack: both
Trim: do-not-trim
SendDigits: send_digits
StatusCallback: "https://example.com"
StatusCallbackMethod: GET
Timeout: 1
To: "+123456789"
Url: "https://example.com"
CallerId: Caller
MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold: 3000
MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold: 3000
MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout: 3000
AsyncAmd: "true"
AsyncAmdStatusCallback: "http://statuscallback.com"
AsyncAmdStatusCallbackMethod: POST
MachineDetectionEngine: Lumenvox
MachineDetectionMinWordLength: 100
MachineDetectionMaxWordLength: 5000
MachineDetectionWordsSilence: 50
MachineDetectionMaxNumOfWords: 5
MachineDetectionSilenceThreshold: 256
Byoc: BYaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
CallReason: "Reason for the call (Beta)"
TimeLimit: 3600
CallToken: call-token-string
Transcribe: "true"
TranscriptionConfiguration: JVaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
ClientNotificationUrl: "https://clientnotification.com"
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-outgoing-call-to-phones-sip-enabled-endpoints-or-twilio-client-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that will create the resource.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» To|body|string(endpoint)|true|The phone number, SIP address, or client identifier to call.|
|» From|body|string(endpoint)|true|The phone number or client identifier to use as the caller id. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `From` must also be a phone number.|
|» Method|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `url` parameter's value. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» FallbackUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we call using the `fallback_method` if an error occurs when requesting or executing the TwiML at `url`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» FallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method that we should use to request the `fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application. If no `status_callback_event` is specified, we will send the `completed` status. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored. URLs must contain a valid hostname (underscores are not permitted).|
|» StatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The call progress events that we will send to the `status_callback` URL. Can be: `initiated`, `ringing`, `answered`, and `completed`. If no event is specified, we send the `completed` status. If you want to receive multiple events, specify each one in a separate `status_callback_event` parameter. See the code sample for [monitoring call progress](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource?code-sample=code-create-a-call-resource-and-specify-a-statuscallbackevent&code-sdk-version=json). If an `application_sid` is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» SendDigits|body|string|false|The string of keys to dial after connecting to the number, with a maximum length of 32 digits. Valid digits in the string include any digit (`0`-`9`), '`A`', '`B`', '`C`', '`D`', '`#`', and '`*`'. You can also use '`w`' to insert a half-second pause and '`W`' to insert a one-second pause. For example, to pause for one second after connecting and then dial extension 1234 followed by the # key, set this parameter to `W1234#`. Be sure to URL-encode this string because the '`#`' character has special meaning in a URL. If both `SendDigits` and `MachineDetection` parameters are provided, then `MachineDetection` will be ignored.|
|» Timeout|body|integer|false|The integer number of seconds that we should allow the phone to ring before assuming there is no answer. The default is `60` seconds and the maximum is `600` seconds. For some call flows, we will add a 5-second buffer to the timeout value you provide. For this reason, a timeout value of 10 seconds could result in an actual timeout closer to 15 seconds. You can set this to a short time, such as `15` seconds, to hang up before reaching an answering machine or voicemail.|
|» Record|body|boolean|false|Whether to record the call. Can be `true` to record the phone call, or `false` to not. The default is `false`. The `recording_url` is sent to the `status_callback` URL.|
|» RecordingChannels|body|string|false|The number of channels in the final recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual`. The default is `mono`. `mono` records both legs of the call in a single channel of the recording file. `dual` records each leg to a separate channel of the recording file. The first channel of a dual-channel recording contains the parent call and the second channel contains the child call.|
|» RecordingStatusCallback|body|string|false|The URL that we call when the recording is available to be accessed.|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `recording_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.|
|» RecordingConfigurationId|body|string|false|The identifier of the configuration to be used when creating and processing the recording|
|» SipAuthUsername|body|string|false|The username used to authenticate the caller making a SIP call.|
|» SipAuthPassword|body|string|false|The password required to authenticate the user account specified in `sip_auth_username`.|
|» MachineDetection|body|string|false|Whether to detect if a human, answering machine, or fax has picked up the call. Can be: `Enable` or `DetectMessageEnd`. Use `Enable` if you would like us to return `AnsweredBy` as soon as the called party is identified. Use `DetectMessageEnd`, if you would like to leave a message on an answering machine. If `send_digits` is provided, this parameter is ignored. For more information, see [Answering Machine Detection](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/answering-machine-detection).|
|» MachineDetectionTimeout|body|integer|false|The number of seconds that we should attempt to detect an answering machine before timing out and sending a voice request with `AnsweredBy` of `unknown`. The default timeout is 30 seconds.|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The recording status events that will trigger calls to the URL specified in `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `in-progress`, `completed` and `absent`. Defaults to `completed`. Separate  multiple values with a space.|
|» Trim|body|string|false|Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence from the recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `trim-silence`.|
|» CallerId|body|string|false|The phone number, SIP address, or Client identifier that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164 format](https://wwnw.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) (e.g., +16175551212). SIP addresses are formatted as `name@company.com`.|
|» MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds that is used as the measuring stick for the length of the speech activity, where durations lower than this value will be interpreted as a human and longer than this value as a machine. Possible Values: 1000-6000. Default: 2400.|
|» MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds of silence after speech activity at which point the speech activity is considered complete. Possible Values: 500-5000. Default: 1200.|
|» MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds of initial silence after which an `unknown` AnsweredBy result will be returned. Possible Values: 2000-10000. Default: 5000.|
|» AsyncAmd|body|string|false|Select whether to perform answering machine detection in the background. Default, blocks the execution of the call until Answering Machine Detection is completed. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|» AsyncAmdStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we should call using the `async_amd_status_callback_method` to notify customer application whether the call was answered by human, machine or fax.|
|» AsyncAmdStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `async_amd_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.|
|» Passports|body|string|false|The STIR/SHAKEN passport for this call, provided as a base64 encoded string. Multiple passports (at max 5) are comma separated and provided as base64 encoded string|
|» Byoc|body|string|false|The SID of a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) trunk to route this call with. Note that `byoc` is only meaningful when `to` is a phone number; it will otherwise be ignored. (Beta)|
|» CallReason|body|string|false|The Reason for the outgoing call. Use it to specify the purpose of the call that is presented on the called party's phone. (Branded Calls Beta)|
|» CallToken|body|string|false|A token string needed to invoke a forwarded call. A call_token is generated when an incoming call is received on a Twilio number. Pass an incoming call's call_token value to a forwarded call via the call_token parameter when creating a new call. A forwarded call should bear the same CallerID of the original incoming call.|
|» RecordingTrack|body|string|false|The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is generated from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and generated by Twilio.|
|» TimeLimit|body|integer|false|The maximum duration of the call in seconds. Constraints depend on account and configuration.|
|» ClientNotificationUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we should use to deliver `push call notification`.|
|» Url|body|string(uri)|false|The absolute URL that returns the TwiML instructions for the call. We will call this URL using the `method` when the call connects. For more information, see the [Url Parameter](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/make-calls#specify-a-url-parameter) section in [Making Calls](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/make-calls).|
|» Twiml|body|string(twiml)|false|TwiML instructions for the call Twilio will use without fetching Twiml from url parameter. If both `twiml` and `url` are provided then `twiml` parameter will be ignored. Max 4000 characters.|
|» ApplicationSid|body|string|false|The SID of the Application resource that will handle the call, if the call will be handled by an application.|

## Initiates a call redirect or terminates a call

<a id="opIdUpdateCall"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls/stringstringstringstringstringstri.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'FallbackMethod=GET&FallbackUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&Method=GET&Status=completed&StatusCallback=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&StatusCallbackUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&StatusCallbackMethod=GET&Url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{Sid}.json`

Initiates a call redirect or terminates a call

> Body parameter

```yaml
FallbackMethod: GET
FallbackUrl: "https://example.com"
Method: GET
Status: completed
StatusCallback: "https://example.com"
StatusCallbackUrl: "https://example.com"
StatusCallbackMethod: GET
Url: "https://example.com"
```

<h3 id="initiates-a-call-redirect-or-terminates-a-call-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Call resource(s) to update.|
|Sid|path|string|true|The Twilio-provided string that uniquely identifies the Call resource to update|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» Url|body|string(uri)|false|The absolute URL that returns the TwiML instructions for the call. We will call this URL using the `method` when the call connects. For more information, see the [Url Parameter](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/make-calls#specify-a-url-parameter) section in [Making Calls](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/make-calls).|
|» Method|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» Status|body|[call_enum_update_status](#schemacall_enum_update_status)|false|none|
|» FallbackUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we call using the `fallback_method` if an error occurs when requesting or executing the TwiML at `url`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» FallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method that we should use to request the `fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application. If no `status_callback_event` is specified, we will send the `completed` status. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored. URLs must contain a valid hostname (underscores are not permitted).|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when requesting the `status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. If an `application_sid` parameter is present, this parameter is ignored.|
|» Twiml|body|string(twiml)|false|TwiML instructions for the call Twilio will use without fetching Twiml from url. Twiml and url parameters are mutually exclusive|
|» TimeLimit|body|integer|false|The maximum duration of the call in seconds. Constraints depend on account and configuration.|

|» Status|completed|
|» FallbackMethod|GET|
|» FallbackMethod|POST|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|GET|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|POST|

## ListCallNotification

<a id="opIdListCallNotification"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Notifications.json \

```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{CallSid}/Notifications.json`

<h3 id="listcallnotification-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Call Notification resources to read.|
|CallSid|path|string|true|The [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) SID of the Call Notification resources to read.|
|Log|query|integer|false|Only read notifications of the specified log level. Can be:  `0` to read only ERROR notifications or `1` to read only WARNING notifications. By default, all notifications are read.|

## Create a recording for the call

<a id="opIdCreateCallRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Recordings.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'RecordingStatusCallbackEvent=%5B%22in-progress%20completed%20failed%22%5D&RecordingStatusCallback=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&RecordingStatusCallbackMethod=GET&Trim=do-not-trim&RecordingChannels=dual&RecordingTrack=both&PlayBeep=true&Transcribe=true&TranscriptionConfiguration=JVaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{CallSid}/Recordings.json`

Create a recording for the call

> Body parameter

```yaml
RecordingStatusCallbackEvent:
  - in-progress completed failed
RecordingStatusCallback: "https://example.com"
RecordingStatusCallbackMethod: GET
Trim: do-not-trim
RecordingChannels: dual
RecordingTrack: both
PlayBeep: true
Transcribe: true
TranscriptionConfiguration: JVaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
```

<h3 id="create-a-recording-for-the-call-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that will create the resource.|
|CallSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) to associate the resource with.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The recording status events on which we should call the `recording_status_callback` URL. Can be: `in-progress`, `completed` and `absent` and the default is `completed`. Separate multiple event values with a space.|
|» RecordingStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `recording_status_callback_method` on each recording event specified in  `recording_status_callback_event`. For more information, see [RecordingStatusCallback parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/recording#recordingstatuscallback).|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.|
|» Trim|body|string|false|Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence in the recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `do-not-trim`. `trim-silence` trims the silence from the beginning and end of the recording and `do-not-trim` does not.|
|» RecordingChannels|body|string|false|The number of channels used in the recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual` and the default is `mono`. `mono` records all parties of the call into one channel. `dual` records each party of a 2-party call into separate channels.|
|» RecordingTrack|body|string|false|The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is generated from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and generated by Twilio.|
|» RecordingConfigurationId|body|string|false|The identifier of the configuration to be used when creating and processing the recording|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackMethod|GET|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackMethod|POST|

```json
  "api_version": "2010-04-01",
```

## Changes the status of the recording to paused, stopped, or in-progress. Note: Pass `Twilio.CURRENT` instead of recording sid to reference current active recording.

<a id="opIdUpdateCallRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Calls/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Recordings/string.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'Status=paused&PauseBehavior=skip&PlayBeep=true'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{CallSid}/Recordings/{Sid}.json`

Changes the status of the recording to paused, stopped, or in-progress. Note: Pass `Twilio.CURRENT` instead of recording sid to reference current active recording.

> Body parameter

```yaml
Status: paused
PauseBehavior: skip
PlayBeep: true
```

<h3 id="changes-the-status-of-the-recording-to-paused-stopped-or-in-progress-note-pass-twiliocurrent-instead-of-recording-sid-to-reference-current-active-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Recording resource to update.|
|CallSid|path|string|true|The [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) SID of the resource to update.|
|Sid|path|string|true|The Twilio-provided string that uniquely identifies the Recording resource to update.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» Status|body|[call_recording_enum_status](#schemacall_recording_enum_status)|true|The status of the recording. Can be: `processing`, `completed` and `absent`. For more detailed statuses on in-progress recordings, check out how to [Update a Recording Resource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/recording#update-a-recording-resource).|
|» PauseBehavior|body|string|false|Whether to record during a pause. Can be: `skip` or `silence` and the default is `silence`. `skip` does not record during the pause period, while `silence` will replace the actual audio of the call with silence during the pause period. This parameter only applies when setting `status` is set to `paused`.|

## Changes the status of the recording to paused, stopped, or in-progress. Note: To use `Twilio.CURRENT`, pass it as recording sid.

<a id="opIdUpdateConferenceRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Conferences/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Recordings/string.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'Status=paused&PauseBehavior=skip&PlayBeep=true'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Conferences/{ConferenceSid}/Recordings/{Sid}.json`

Changes the status of the recording to paused, stopped, or in-progress. Note: To use `Twilio.CURRENT`, pass it as recording sid.

> Body parameter

```yaml
Status: paused
PauseBehavior: skip
PlayBeep: true
```

<h3 id="changes-the-status-of-the-recording-to-paused-stopped-or-in-progress-note-to-use-twiliocurrent-pass-it-as-recording-sid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|ConferenceSid|path|string|true|The Conference SID that identifies the conference associated with the recording to update.|
|Sid|path|string|true|The Twilio-provided string that uniquely identifies the Conference Recording resource to update. Use `Twilio.CURRENT` to reference the current active recording.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» Status|body|[conference_recording_enum_status](#schemaconference_recording_enum_status)|true|The status of the recording. Can be: `processing`, `completed` and `absent`. For more detailed statuses on in-progress recordings, check out how to [Update a Recording Resource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/recording#update-a-recording-resource).|
|» PauseBehavior|body|string|false|Whether to record during a pause. Can be: `skip` or `silence` and the default is `silence`. `skip` does not record during the pause period, while `silence` will replace the actual audio of the call with silence during the pause period. This parameter only applies when setting `status` is set to `paused`.|


`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/Local.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumberlocal-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|

## Send a message

<a id="opIdCreateMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Messages.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'ApplicationSid=APaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa&Body=Hello!%20%F0%9F%91%8D&From=%2B14155552345&MediaUrl=%5B%22https%3A%2F%2Fc1.staticflickr.com%2F3%2F2899%2F14341091933_1e92e62d12_b.jpg%22%5D&PersistentAction=%5B%22mailto%3Atest%40example.com%22%5D&StatusCallback=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&To=%2B14155552345&Tags=%7B%22campaign_name%22%3A%20%22Spring%20Sale%202022%22%2C%22message_type%22%3A%20%22cart_abandoned%22%7D'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json`

Send a message

> Body parameter

```yaml
ApplicationSid: APaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Body: "Hello! 👍"
From: "+14155552345"
MediaUrl:
  - "https://c1.staticflickr.com/3/2899/14341091933_1e92e62d12_b.jpg"
PersistentAction:
  - "mailto:test@example.com"
StatusCallback: "https://example.com"
To: "+14155552345"
Tags: "{\"campaign_name\": \"Spring Sale 2022\",\"message_type\": \"cart_abandoned\"}"
```

<h3 id="send-a-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) creating the Message resource.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» To|body|string(phone-number)|true|The recipient's phone number in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (for SMS/MMS) or [channel address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/channels), e.g. `whatsapp:+15552229999`.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL of the endpoint to which Twilio sends [Message status callback requests](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource#twilios-request-to-the-statuscallback-url). URL must contain a valid hostname and underscores are not allowed. If you include this parameter with the `messaging_service_sid`, Twilio uses this URL instead of the Status Callback URL of the [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/api/service-resource). |
|» ApplicationSid|body|string|false|The SID of the associated [TwiML Application](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/applications). [Message status callback requests](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource#twilios-request-to-the-statuscallback-url) are sent to the TwiML App's `message_status_callback` URL. Note that the `status_callback` parameter of a request takes priority over the `application_sid` parameter; if both are included `application_sid` is ignored.|
|» MaxPrice|body|number|false|[OBSOLETE] This parameter will no longer have any effect as of 2024-06-03.|
|» ProvideFeedback|body|boolean|false|Boolean indicating whether or not you intend to provide delivery confirmation feedback to Twilio (used in conjunction with the [Message Feedback subresource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-feedback-resource)). Default value is `false`.|
|» Attempt|body|integer|false|Total number of attempts made (including this request) to send the message regardless of the provider used|
|» ValidityPeriod|body|integer|false|The maximum length in seconds that the Message can remain in Twilio's outgoing message queue. If a queued Message exceeds the `validity_period`, the Message is not sent. Accepted values are integers from `1` to `36000`. Default value is `36000`. A `validity_period` greater than `5` is recommended. [Learn more about the validity period](https://www.twilio.com/blog/take-more-control-of-outbound-messages-using-validity-period-html)|
|» ForceDelivery|body|boolean|false|Reserved|
|» ContentRetention|body|[message_enum_content_retention](#schemamessage_enum_content_retention)|false|Determines if the message content can be stored or redacted based on privacy settings|
|» AddressRetention|body|[message_enum_address_retention](#schemamessage_enum_address_retention)|false|Determines if the address can be stored or obfuscated based on privacy settings|
|» SmartEncoded|body|boolean|false|Whether to detect Unicode characters that have a similar GSM-7 character and replace them. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|» PersistentAction|body|[string]|false|Rich actions for non-SMS/MMS channels. Used for [sending location in WhatsApp messages](https://www.twilio.com/docs/whatsapp/message-features#location-messages-with-whatsapp).|
|» TrafficType|body|[message_enum_traffic_type](#schemamessage_enum_traffic_type)|false|none|
|» ShortenUrls|body|boolean|false|For Messaging Services with [Link Shortening configured](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/link-shortening) only: A Boolean indicating whether or not Twilio should shorten links in the `body` of the Message. Default value is `false`. If `true`, the `messaging_service_sid` parameter must also be provided.|
|» ScheduleType|body|[message_enum_schedule_type](#schemamessage_enum_schedule_type)|false|For Messaging Services only: Include this parameter with a value of `fixed` in conjuction with the `send_time` parameter in order to [schedule a Message](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/message-scheduling).|
|» SendAt|body|string(date-time)|false|The time that Twilio will send the message. Must be in ISO 8601 format.|
|» SendAsMms|body|boolean|false|If set to `true`, Twilio delivers the message as a single MMS message, regardless of the presence of media.|
|» ContentVariables|body|string|false|For [Content Editor/API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content) only: Key-value pairs of [Template variables](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/using-variables-with-content-api) and their substitution values. `content_sid` parameter must also be provided. If values are not defined in the `content_variables` parameter, the [Template's default placeholder values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#create-templates) are used.|
|» MessageIntent|body|string|false|Specifies the purpose or use case of the outbound communication. This parameter is used by Twilio's [Traffic Shaping](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/traffic-shaping) and [Compliance Toolkit](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/compliance-toolkit) products. Possible values include: `otp`, `notifications`, `marketing`, `fraud`, `security`, `customercare`, `delivery`, `education`, `polling`, `announcements`, and `events`.|
|» RiskCheck|body|[message_enum_risk_check](#schemamessage_enum_risk_check)|false|Include this parameter with a value of `disable` to skip any kind of risk check on the respective message request.|
|» From|body|string(phone-number)|false|The sender's Twilio phone number (in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format), [alphanumeric sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/quickstart), [Wireless SIM](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iot/wireless/programmable-wireless-send-machine-machine-sms-commands), [short code](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/messaging/channels/sms/short-codes), or [channel address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/channels) (e.g., `whatsapp:+15554449999`). The value of the `from` parameter must be a sender that is hosted within Twilio and belongs to the Account creating the Message. If you are using `messaging_service_sid`, this parameter can be empty (Twilio assigns a `from` value from the Messaging Service's Sender Pool) or you can provide a specific sender from your Sender Pool.|
|» FallbackFrom|body|string(phone-number)|false|A fallback SMS sender to use when the recipient cannot be reached over RCS. This parameter may only be used when also providing a [Messaging Service](https://twilio.com/docs/messaging/services) containing an RCS sender. The fallback SMS sender must be either a Twilio phone number (in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format), [alphanumeric sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/quickstart), or [short code](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/messaging/channels/sms/short-codes), hosted within Twilio and belong to the Account creating the Message.|
|» MessagingServiceSid|body|string|false|The SID of the [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services) you want to associate with the Message. When this parameter is provided and the `from` parameter is omitted, Twilio selects the optimal sender from the Messaging Service's Sender Pool. You may also provide a `from` parameter if you want to use a specific Sender from the Sender Pool.|
|» Body|body|string|false|The text content of the outgoing message. Can be up to 1,600 characters in length. SMS only: If the `body` contains more than 160 [GSM-7](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-gsm-7-character-encoding) characters (or 70 [UCS-2](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-ucs-2-character-encoding) characters), the message is segmented and charged accordingly. For long `body` text, consider using the [send_as_mms parameter](https://www.twilio.com/blog/mms-for-long-text-messages).|
|» MediaUrl|body|[string(uri)]|false|The URL of media to include in the Message content. `jpeg`, `jpg`, `gif`, and `png` file types are fully supported by Twilio and content is formatted for delivery on destination devices. The media size limit is 5 MB for supported file types (`jpeg`, `jpg`, `png`, `gif`) and 500 KB for [other types](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/guides/accepted-mime-types) of accepted media. To send more than one image in the message, provide multiple `media_url` parameters in the POST request. You can include up to ten `media_url` parameters per message. [International](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223179808-Sending-and-receiving-MMS-messages) and [carrier](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223133707-Is-MMS-supported-for-all-carriers-in-US-and-Canada-) limits apply.|
|» ContentSid|body|string|false|For [Content Editor/API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content) only: The SID of the Content Template to be used with the Message, e.g., `HXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX`. If this parameter is not provided, a Content Template is not used. Find the SID in the Console on the Content Editor page. For Content API users, the SID is found in Twilio's response when [creating the Template](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#create-templates) or by [fetching your Templates](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/content-api-resources#fetch-all-content-resources).|

## ListAvailablePhoneNumberMobile

<a id="opIdListAvailablePhoneNumberMobile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/AvailablePhoneNumbers/string/Mobile.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/Mobile.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumbermobile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

```json
{
  "available_phone_numbers": [
    {
      "address_requirements": "none",

      "capabilities": {
        "mms": false,
        "sms": true,
        "voice": false
      },
      "friendly_name": "+4759440374",
      "iso_country": "NO",
      "lata": null,
      "latitude": null,
      "locality": null,
      "longitude": null,
      "phone_number": "+4759440374",
      "postal_code": null,
      "rate_center": null,
      "region": null
    }
  ],
  "uri": "/2010-04-01/Accounts/ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/AvailablePhoneNumbers/US/Mobile.json"
}
```


`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Usage/Records/Monthly.json`

<h3 id="listusagerecordmonthly-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the UsageRecord resources to read.|
|Category|query|string|false|The [usage category](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/usage-record#usage-categories) of the UsageRecord resources to read. Only UsageRecord resources in the specified category are retrieved.|
|StartDate|query|string(date)|false|Only include usage that has occurred on or after this date. Specify the date in GMT and format as `YYYY-MM-DD`. You can also specify offsets from the current date, such as: `-30days`, which will set the start date to be 30 days before the current date.|

<h1 id="twilio---api-api20100401national">Api20100401National</h1>

## ListAvailablePhoneNumberNational

<a id="opIdListAvailablePhoneNumberNational"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/AvailablePhoneNumbers/string/National.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/National.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumbernational-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

## Update the properties of the participant

<a id="opIdUpdateParticipant"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Conferences/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Participants/string.json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \

  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'Muted=true'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Conferences/{ConferenceSid}/Participants/{CallSid}.json`

Update the properties of the participant

> Body parameter

```yaml
Muted: "true"
```

<h3 id="update-the-properties-of-the-participant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Participant resources to update.|
|ConferenceSid|path|string|true|The SID of the conference with the participant to update.|
|CallSid|path|string|true|The [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) SID or label of the participant to update. Non URL safe characters in a label must be percent encoded, for example, a space character is represented as %20.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» Muted|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be muted. Can be `true` or `false`. `true` will mute the participant, and `false` will un-mute them. Anything value other than `true` or `false` is interpreted as `false`.|
|» Hold|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant should be on hold. Can be: `true` or `false`. `true` puts the participant on hold, and `false` lets them rejoin the conference.|
|» HoldUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we call using the `hold_method` for music that plays when the participant is on hold. The URL may return an MP3 file, a WAV file, or a TwiML document that contains `<Play>`, `<Say>`, `<Pause>`, or `<Redirect>` verbs.|
|» HoldMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `hold_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `GET`.|
|» AnnounceUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we call using the `announce_method` for an announcement to the participant. The URL may return an MP3 file, a WAV file, or a TwiML document that contains `<Play>`, `<Say>`, `<Pause>`, or `<Redirect>` verbs.|
|» AnnounceMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `announce_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.|
|» WaitUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that Twilio calls using the `wait_method` before the conference has started. The URL may return an MP3 file, a WAV file, or a TwiML document. The default value is the URL of our standard hold music. If you do not want anything to play while waiting for the conference to start, specify an empty string by setting `wait_url` to `''`. For more details on the allowable verbs within the `waitUrl`, see the `waitUrl` attribute in the [<Conference> TwiML instruction](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml/conference#attributes-waiturl).|
|» WaitMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `wait_url`. Can be `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. When using a static audio file, this should be `GET` so that we can cache the file.|
|» BeepOnExit|body|boolean|false|Whether to play a notification beep to the conference when the participant exits. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|» EndConferenceOnExit|body|boolean|false|Whether to end the conference when the participant leaves. Can be: `true` or `false` and defaults to `false`.|
|» Coaching|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant is coaching another call. Can be: `true` or `false`. If not present, defaults to `false` unless `call_sid_to_coach` is defined. If `true`, `call_sid_to_coach` must be defined.|
|» CallSidToCoach|body|string|false|The SID of the participant who is being `coached`. The participant being coached is the only participant who can hear the participant who is `coaching`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» HoldMethod|GET|
|» HoldMethod|POST|
|» AnnounceMethod|GET|
|» AnnounceMethod|POST|
|» WaitMethod|GET|
|» WaitMethod|POST|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "account_sid": "ACaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "call_sid": "CAaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "label": null,
  "conference_sid": "CFaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "date_created": "Fri, 18 Feb 2011 21:07:19 +0000",
  "date_updated": "Fri, 18 Feb 2011 21:07:19 +0000",
```

```yaml
TimeLimit: 3600
CallToken: call-token-string
MachineDetection: enable
MachineDetectionTimeout: 15
MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold: 3000
MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold: 3000
MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout: 3000
AmdStatusCallback: "http://statuscallback.com"
AmdStatusCallbackMethod: POST
MachineDetectionEngine: Lumenvox
MachineDetectionMinWordLength: 100
MachineDetectionMaxWordLength: 5000
MachineDetectionWordsSilence: 50
MachineDetectionMaxNumOfWords: 5
MachineDetectionSilenceThreshold: 256
ClientNotificationUrl: "https://clientnotification.com"
CallerDisplayName: John Doe
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that will create the resource.|

|body|body|object|false|none|
|» From|body|string(endpoint)|true|The phone number, Client identifier, or username portion of SIP address that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `from` must also be a phone number. If `to` is sip address, this value of `from` should be a username portion to be used to populate the P-Asserted-Identity header that is passed to the SIP endpoint.|
|» To|body|string(endpoint)|true|The phone number, SIP address, Client, TwiML App identifier that received this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). SIP addresses are formatted as `sip:name@company.com`. Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. TwiML App identifiers are formatted `app:<APP_SID>`. [Custom parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/conference-participant-resource#custom-parameters) may also be specified.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information to your application.|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `status_callback`. Can be: `GET` and `POST` and defaults to `POST`.|
|» StatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The conference state changes that should generate a call to `status_callback`. Can be: `initiated`, `ringing`, `answered`, and `completed`. Separate multiple values with a space. The default value is `completed`.|
|» Label|body|string|false|A label for this participant. If one is supplied, it may subsequently be used to fetch, update or delete the participant.|
|» Timeout|body|integer|false|The number of seconds that we should allow the phone to ring before assuming there is no answer. Can be an integer between `5` and `600`, inclusive. The default value is `60`. We always add a 5-second timeout buffer to outgoing calls, so  value of 10 would result in an actual timeout that was closer to 15 seconds.|
|» Record|body|boolean|false|Whether to record the participant and their conferences, including the time between conferences. Can be `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|» Muted|body|boolean|false|Whether the agent is muted in the conference. Can be `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|» Beep|body|string|false|Whether to play a notification beep to the conference when the participant joins. Can be: `true`, `false`, `onEnter`, or `onExit`. The default value is `true`.|
|» StartConferenceOnEnter|body|boolean|false|Whether to start the conference when the participant joins, if it has not already started. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`. If `false` and the conference has not started, the participant is muted and hears background music until another participant starts the conference.|
|» EndConferenceOnExit|body|boolean|false|Whether to end the conference when the participant leaves. Can be: `true` or `false` and defaults to `false`.|
|» WaitUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that Twilio calls using the `wait_method` before the conference has started. The URL may return an MP3 file, a WAV file, or a TwiML document. The default value is the URL of our standard hold music. If you do not want anything to play while waiting for the conference to start, specify an empty string by setting `wait_url` to `''`. For more details on the allowable verbs within the `waitUrl`, see the `waitUrl` attribute in the [<Conference> TwiML instruction](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml/conference#attributes-waiturl).|
|» WaitMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `wait_url`. Can be `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`. When using a static audio file, this should be `GET` so that we can cache the file.|
|» EarlyMedia|body|boolean|false|Whether to allow an agent to hear the state of the outbound call, including ringing or disconnect messages. Can be: `true` or `false` and defaults to `true`.|
|» MaxParticipants|body|integer|false|The maximum number of participants in the conference. Can be a positive integer from `2` to `250`. The default value is `250`.|
|» ConferenceRecord|body|string|false|Whether to record the conference the participant is joining. Can be: `true`, `false`, `record-from-start`, and `do-not-record`. The default value is `false`.|
|» ConferenceTrim|body|string|false|Whether to trim leading and trailing silence from the conference recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and defaults to `trim-silence`.|
|» ConferenceStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `conference_status_callback_method` when the conference events in `conference_status_callback_event` occur. Only the value set by the first participant to join the conference is used. Subsequent `conference_status_callback` values are ignored.|
|» ConferenceStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `conference_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.|
|» ConferenceStatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The conference state changes that should generate a call to `conference_status_callback`. Can be: `start`, `end`, `join`, `leave`, `mute`, `hold`, `modify`, `speaker`, and `announcement`. Separate multiple values with a space. Defaults to `start end`.|
|» RecordingChannels|body|string|false|The recording channels for the final recording. Can be: `mono` or `dual` and the default is `mono`.|
|» RecordingStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we should call using the `recording_status_callback_method` when the recording status changes.|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when we call `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.|
|» SipAuthUsername|body|string|false|The SIP username used for authentication.|
|» SipAuthPassword|body|string|false|The SIP password for authentication.|
|» Region|body|string|false|The [region](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223132167-How-global-low-latency-routing-and-region-selection-work-for-conferences-and-Client-calls) where we should mix the recorded audio. Can be:`us1`, `us2`, `ie1`, `de1`, `sg1`, `br1`, `au1`, or `jp1`.|
|» ConferenceRecordingStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `conference_recording_status_callback_method` when the conference recording is available.|
|» ConferenceRecordingStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `conference_recording_status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and defaults to `POST`.|
|» RecordingStatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The recording state changes that should generate a call to `recording_status_callback`. Can be: `started`, `in-progress`, `paused`, `resumed`, `stopped`, `completed`, `failed`, and `absent`. Separate multiple values with a space, ex: `'in-progress completed failed'`.|
|» ConferenceRecordingStatusCallbackEvent|body|[string]|false|The conference recording state changes that generate a call to `conference_recording_status_callback`. Can be: `in-progress`, `completed`, `failed`, and `absent`. Separate multiple values with a space, ex: `'in-progress completed failed'`|
|» Coaching|body|boolean|false|Whether the participant is coaching another call. Can be: `true` or `false`. If not present, defaults to `false` unless `call_sid_to_coach` is defined. If `true`, `call_sid_to_coach` must be defined.|
|» CallSidToCoach|body|string|false|The SID of the participant who is being `coached`. The participant being coached is the only participant who can hear the participant who is `coaching`.|
|» JitterBufferSize|body|string|false|Jitter buffer size for the connecting participant. Twilio will use this setting to apply Jitter Buffer before participant's audio is mixed into the conference. Can be: `off`, `small`, `medium`, and `large`. Default to `large`.|
|» Byoc|body|string|false|The SID of a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) trunk to route this call with. Note that `byoc` is only meaningful when `to` is a phone number; it will otherwise be ignored. (Beta)|
|» CallerId|body|string|false|The phone number, Client identifier, or username portion of SIP address that made this call. Phone numbers are in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format (e.g., +16175551212). Client identifiers are formatted `client:name`. If using a phone number, it must be a Twilio number or a Verified [outgoing caller id](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/outgoing-caller-ids) for your account. If the `to` parameter is a phone number, `callerId` must also be a phone number. If `to` is sip address, this value of `callerId` should be a username portion to be used to populate the From header that is passed to the SIP endpoint.|
|» CallReason|body|string|false|The Reason for the outgoing call. Use it to specify the purpose of the call that is presented on the called party's phone. (Branded Calls Beta)|
|» RecordingTrack|body|string|false|The audio track to record for the call. Can be: `inbound`, `outbound` or `both`. The default is `both`. `inbound` records the audio that is received by Twilio. `outbound` records the audio that is sent from Twilio. `both` records the audio that is received and sent by Twilio.|
|» RecordingConfigurationId|body|string|false|The identifier of the configuration to be used when creating and processing the recording|
|» TimeLimit|body|integer|false|The maximum duration of the call in seconds. Constraints depend on account and configuration.|
|» MachineDetection|body|string|false|Whether to detect if a human, answering machine, or fax has picked up the call. Can be: `Enable` or `DetectMessageEnd`. Use `Enable` if you would like us to return `AnsweredBy` as soon as the called party is identified. Use `DetectMessageEnd`, if you would like to leave a message on an answering machine. For more information, see [Answering Machine Detection](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/answering-machine-detection).|
|» MachineDetectionTimeout|body|integer|false|The number of seconds that we should attempt to detect an answering machine before timing out and sending a voice request with `AnsweredBy` of `unknown`. The default timeout is 30 seconds.|
|» MachineDetectionSpeechThreshold|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds that is used as the measuring stick for the length of the speech activity, where durations lower than this value will be interpreted as a human and longer than this value as a machine. Possible Values: 1000-6000. Default: 2400.|
|» MachineDetectionSpeechEndThreshold|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds of silence after speech activity at which point the speech activity is considered complete. Possible Values: 500-5000. Default: 1200.|
|» MachineDetectionSilenceTimeout|body|integer|false|The number of milliseconds of initial silence after which an `unknown` AnsweredBy result will be returned. Possible Values: 2000-10000. Default: 5000.|
|» AmdStatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we should call using the `amd_status_callback_method` to notify customer application whether the call was answered by human, machine or fax.|
|» AmdStatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use when calling the `amd_status_callback` URL. Can be: `GET` or `POST` and the default is `POST`.|
|» Trim|body|string|false|Whether to trim any leading and trailing silence from the participant recording. Can be: `trim-silence` or `do-not-trim` and the default is `trim-silence`.|
|» CallToken|body|string|false|A token string needed to invoke a forwarded call. A call_token is generated when an incoming call is received on a Twilio number.
