|» Passports|body|string|false|The STIR/SHAKEN passport for this call, provided as a base64 encoded string. Multiple passports (at max 5) are comma separated and provided as base64 encoded string|
|» ClientNotificationUrl|body|string(uri)|false|The URL that we should use to deliver `push call notification`.|
|» CallerDisplayName|body|string|false|The name that populates the display name in the From header. Must be between 2 and 255 characters. Only applicable for calls to sip address.|
|» EmergencyCallerPosition|body|string|false|The emergency caller's GPS coordinates in decimal degrees format.<br>Format: "latitude longitude" (space-separated)<br>- Latitude: decimal degrees, range -90.0 to +90.0 (negative for South, positive for North)<br>- Longitude: decimal degrees, range -180.0 to +180.0 (negative for West, positive for East)<br>- Precision: up to 6 decimal places recommended for meter-level accuracy<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 150 characters, only the first 150 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyCallerLocation|body|string|false|The emergency caller's physical location description within a building or facility.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyName|body|string|false|The emergency caller's organization or entity name.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyAddress|body|string|false|The emergency caller's street address including street number and street name.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 60 characters, only the first 60 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyZipCode|body|string|false|The emergency caller's postal code or ZIP code.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyCity|body|string|false|The emergency caller's city or municipality name.<br>Should be the official city name as recognized by local authorities.<br>Used in combination with state and country for emergency call routing.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyState|body|string|false|The emergency caller's state or province.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|
|» EmergencyCountry|body|string|false|The emergency caller's country. Currently supported US and CA only.<br><br>Note: If the value exceeds 20 characters, only the first 20 characters will be used.<br>|

```bash
  -d 'ChargeAmount=12.00&Currency=USD&Description=api%20testing&IdempotencyKey=abcd&Input=dtmf&Parameter=%7B'\''name'\''%3A'\''foobar'\''%7D&PaymentConnector=stripe_connector&PaymentMethod=credit-card&PostalCode=true&SecurityCode=true&StatusCallback=https%3A%2F%2Fmyapp.com%2Fpayments&ValidCardTypes=visa%20amex'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{CallSid}/Payments.json`

create an instance of payments. This will start a new payments session

> Body parameter

```yaml
ChargeAmount: "12.00"
Currency: USD
Description: api testing
IdempotencyKey: abcd
Input: dtmf
Parameter: "{'name':'foobar'}"
PaymentConnector: stripe_connector
PaymentMethod: credit-card
PostalCode: true
SecurityCode: true
StatusCallback: "https://myapp.com/payments"
ValidCardTypes: visa amex
```

<h3 id="create-an-instance-of-payments-this-will-start-a-new-payments-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that will create the resource.|
|CallSid|path|string|true|The SID of the call that will create the resource. Call leg associated with this sid is expected to provide payment information thru DTMF.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» IdempotencyKey|body|string|true|A unique token that will be used to ensure that multiple API calls with the same information do not result in multiple transactions. This should be a unique string value per API call and can be a randomly generated.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|true|Provide an absolute or relative URL to receive status updates regarding your Pay session. Read more about the [expected StatusCallback values](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/payment-resource#statuscallback)|
|» BankAccountType|body|[payments_enum_bank_account_type](#schemapayments_enum_bank_account_type)|false|Type of bank account if payment source is ACH. One of `consumer-checking`, `consumer-savings`, or `commercial-checking`. The default value is `consumer-checking`.|
|» ChargeAmount|body|number|false|A positive decimal value less than 1,000,000 to charge against the credit card or bank account. Default currency can be overwritten with `currency` field. Leave blank or set to 0 to tokenize.|
|» Currency|body|string|false|The currency of the `charge_amount`, formatted as [ISO 4127](http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/currency_codes.htm) format. The default value is `USD` and all values allowed from the Pay Connector are accepted.|
|» Description|body|string|false|The description can be used to provide more details regarding the transaction. This information is submitted along with the payment details to the Payment Connector which are then posted on the transactions.|
|» Input|body|string|false|A list of inputs that should be accepted. Currently only `dtmf` is supported. All digits captured during a pay session are redacted from the logs.|
|» MinPostalCodeLength|body|integer|false|A positive integer that is used to validate the length of the `PostalCode` inputted by the user. User must enter this many digits.|
|» Parameter|body|object|false|A single-level JSON object used to pass custom parameters to payment processors. (Required for ACH payments). The information that has to be included here depends on the <Pay> Connector. [Read more](https://www.twilio.com/console/voice/pay-connectors).|
|» PaymentConnector|body|string|false|This is the unique name corresponding to the Pay Connector installed in the Twilio Add-ons. Learn more about [<Pay> Connectors](https://www.twilio.com/console/voice/pay-connectors). The default value is `Default`.|
|» PaymentMethod|body|[payments_enum_payment_method](#schemapayments_enum_payment_method)|false|Type of payment being captured. One of `credit-card` or `ach-debit`. The default value is `credit-card`.|
|» PostalCode|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the credit card postal code (zip code) is a required piece of payment information that must be provided by the caller. The default is `true`.|
|» SecurityCode|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the credit card security code is a required piece of payment information that must be provided by the caller. The default is `true`.|
|» Timeout|body|integer|false|The number of seconds that <Pay> should wait for the caller to press a digit between each subsequent digit, after the first one, before moving on to validate the digits captured. The default is `5`, maximum is `600`.|
|» TokenType|body|[payments_enum_token_type](#schemapayments_enum_token_type)|false|Indicates whether the payment method should be tokenized as a `one-time`, `reusable`, or `payment-method` token. The default value is `reusable`. Do not enter a charge amount when tokenizing. If a charge amount is entered, the payment method will be charged and not tokenized.|
|» ValidCardTypes|body|string|false|Credit card types separated by space that Pay should accept. The default value is `visa mastercard amex`|
|» RequireMatchingInputs|body|string|false|A comma-separated list of payment information fields that require the caller to enter the same value twice for confirmation. Supported values are `payment-card-number`, `expiration-date`, `security-code`, and `postal-code`.|
|» Confirmation|body|string|false|Whether to prompt the caller to confirm their payment information before submitting to the payment gateway. If `true`, the caller will hear the last 4 digits of their card or account number and must press 1 to confirm or 2 to cancel. Default is `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» BankAccountType|consumer-checking|
|» BankAccountType|consumer-savings|
|» BankAccountType|commercial-checking|
|» PaymentMethod|credit-card|
|» PaymentMethod|ach-debit|
|» TokenType|one-time|
|» TokenType|reusable|
|» TokenType|payment-method|
|» Confirmation|true|
|» Confirmation|false|


`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Usage/Records.json`

Retrieve a list of usage-records belonging to the account used to make the request

<h3 id="retrieve-a-list-of-usage-records-belonging-to-the-account-used-to-make-the-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the UsageRecord resources to read.|
|Category|query|string|false|The [usage category](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/usage-record#usage-categories) of the UsageRecord resources to read. Only UsageRecord resources in the specified category are retrieved.|
|StartDate|query|string(date)|false|Only include usage that has occurred on or after this date. Specify the date in GMT and format as `YYYY-MM-DD`. You can also specify offsets from the current date, such as: `-30days`, which will set the start date to be 30 days before the current date.|
|EndDate|query|string(date)|false|Only include usage that occurred on or before this date. Specify the date in GMT and format as `YYYY-MM-DD`.  You can also specify offsets from the current date, such as: `+30days`, which will set the end date to 30 days from the current date.|
|IncludeSubaccounts|query|boolean|false|Whether to include usage from the master account and all its subaccounts. Can be: `true` (the default) to include usage from the master account and all subaccounts or `false` to retrieve usage from only the specified account.|

<a id="opIdListAvailablePhoneNumberSharedCost"></a>

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/SharedCost.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumbersharedcost-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

```json
      },
```

## ListUsageRecordThisMonth

<a id="opIdListUsageRecordThisMonth"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/Usage/Records/ThisMonth.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Usage/Records/ThisMonth.json`

<h3 id="listusagerecordthismonth-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the UsageRecord resources to read.|
|Category|query|string|false|The [usage category](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/usage-record#usage-categories) of the UsageRecord resources to read. Only UsageRecord resources in the specified category are retrieved.|
|StartDate|query|string(date)|false|Only include usage that has occurred on or after this date. Specify the date in GMT and format as `YYYY-MM-DD`. You can also specify offsets from the current date, such as: `-30days`, which will set the start date to be 30 days before the current date.|
|EndDate|query|string(date)|false|Only include usage that occurred on or before this date. Specify the date in GMT and format as `YYYY-MM-DD`.  You can also specify offsets from the current date, such as: `+30days`, which will set the end date to 30 days from the current date.|
|IncludeSubaccounts|query|boolean|false|Whether to include usage from the master account and all its subaccounts. Can be: `true` (the default) to include usage from the master account and all subaccounts or `false` to retrieve usage from only the specified account.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

## ListAvailablePhoneNumberTollFree

<a id="opIdListAvailablePhoneNumberTollFree"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/AvailablePhoneNumbers/string/TollFree.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/TollFree.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumbertollfree-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/OutgoingCallerIds.json \
```
```bash
  -X POST \
```

```bash
  -d 'CallDelay=100&Extension=extension&FriendlyName=friendly_name&PhoneNumber=%2B18001234567&StatusCallback=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.example.com&StatusCallbackMethod=GET'
```

`POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/OutgoingCallerIds.json`

> Body parameter

```yaml
CallDelay: 100
Extension: extension
FriendlyName: friendly_name
PhoneNumber: "+18001234567"
StatusCallback: "http://www.example.com"
StatusCallbackMethod: GET
```

<h3 id="createvalidationrequest-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) responsible for the new caller ID resource.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» PhoneNumber|body|string(phone-number)|true|The phone number to verify in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format, which consists of a + followed by the country code and subscriber number.|
|» FriendlyName|body|string|false|A descriptive string that you create to describe the new caller ID resource. It can be up to 64 characters long. The default value is a formatted version of the phone number.|
|» CallDelay|body|integer|false|The number of seconds to delay before initiating the verification call. Can be an integer between `0` and `60`, inclusive. The default is `0`.|
|» Extension|body|string|false|The digits to dial after connecting the verification call.|
|» StatusCallback|body|string(uri)|false|The URL we should call using the `status_callback_method` to send status information about the verification process to your application.|
|» StatusCallbackMethod|body|string(http-method)|false|The HTTP method we should use to call `status_callback`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`, and the default is `POST`.|

## ListAvailablePhoneNumberVoip

<a id="opIdListAvailablePhoneNumberVoip"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/stringstringstringstringstringstri/AvailablePhoneNumbers/string/Voip.json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/AvailablePhoneNumbers/{CountryCode}/Voip.json`

<h3 id="listavailablephonenumbervoip-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountSid|path|string|true|The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) requesting the AvailablePhoneNumber resources.|
|CountryCode|path|string(iso-country-code)|true|The [ISO-3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code of the country from which to read phone numbers.|
|AreaCode|query|integer|false|The area code of the phone numbers to read. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Contains|query|string|false|Matching pattern to identify phone numbers. This pattern can be between 2 and 16 characters long and allows all digits (0-9) and all non-diacritic latin alphabet letters (a-z, A-Z). It accepts four meta-characters: `*`, `%`, `+`, `$`. The `*` and `%` meta-characters can appear multiple times in the pattern. To match wildcards at the beginning or end of the pattern, use `*` to match any single character or `%` to match a sequence of characters. If you use the wildcard patterns, it must include at least two non-meta-characters, and wildcards cannot be used between non-meta-characters. To match the beginning of a pattern, start the pattern with `+`. To match the end of the pattern, append the pattern with `$`. These meta-characters can't be adjacent to each other.|
|SmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive text messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|MmsEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive MMS messages. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|VoiceEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive calls. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|ExcludeAllAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require an [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeLocalAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a local [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|ExcludeForeignAddressRequired|query|boolean|false|Whether to exclude phone numbers that require a foreign [Address](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/api/address). Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`.|
|Beta|query|boolean|false|Whether to read phone numbers that are new to the Twilio platform. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`.|
|NearNumber|query|string(phone-number)|false|Given a phone number, find a geographically close number within `distance` miles. Distance defaults to 25 miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|NearLatLong|query|string|false|Given a latitude/longitude pair `lat,long` find geographically close numbers within `distance` miles. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|Distance|query|integer|false|The search radius, in miles, for a `near_` query.  Can be up to `500` and the default is `25`. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InPostalCode|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular postal code. Given a phone number, search within the same postal code as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRegion|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular region, state, or province. Given a phone number, search within the same region as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InRateCenter|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific rate center, or given a phone number search within the same rate center as that number. Requires `in_lata` to be set as well. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLata|query|string|false|Limit results to a specific local access and transport area ([LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area)). Given a phone number, search within the same [LATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_access_and_transport_area) as that number. Applies to only phone numbers in the US and Canada.|
|InLocality|query|string|false|Limit results to a particular locality or city. Given a phone number, search within the same Locality as that number.|
|FaxEnabled|query|boolean|false|Whether the phone numbers can receive faxes. Can be: `true` or `false`.|
|PageSize|query|integer(int64)|false|How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.|
|Page|query|integer|false|The page index. This value is simply for client state.|
|PageToken|query|string|false|The page token. This is provided by the API.|

```json
    }

}
```

|owner_account_sid|string \| null|false|none|The unique 34 character id that represents the parent of this account. The OwnerAccountSid of a parent account is it's own sid.|

|status|[account_enum_status](#schemaaccount_enum_status)|false|none|The status of this account. Usually `active`, but can be `suspended` or `closed`.|
|subresource_uris|object(uri-map) \| null|false|none|A Map of various subresources available for the given Account Instance|
|type|[account_enum_type](#schemaaccount_enum_type)|false|none|The type of this account. Either `Trial` or `Full` if it's been upgraded|
|uri|string \| null|false|none|The URI for this resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`|

|duration|string \| null|false|none|The length of the call in seconds. This value is empty for busy, failed, unanswered, or ongoing calls.|
|price|string \| null|false|none|The charge for this call, in the currency associated with the account. Populated after the call is completed. May not be immediately available. The price associated with a call only reflects the charge for connectivity.  Charges for other call-related features such as Answering Machine Detection, Text-To-Speech, and SIP REFER are not included in this value.|
|price_unit|string(currency) \| null|false|none|The currency in which `Price` is measured, in [ISO 4127](https://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/currency_codes.htm) format (e.g., `USD`, `EUR`, `JPY`). Always capitalized for calls.|
|direction|string \| null|false|none|A string describing the direction of the call. Can be: `inbound` for inbound calls, `outbound-api` for calls initiated via the REST API or `outbound-dial` for calls initiated by a `<Dial>` verb. Using [Elastic SIP Trunking](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sip-trunking), the values can be [`trunking-terminating`](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sip-trunking#termination) for outgoing calls from your communications infrastructure to the PSTN or [`trunking-originating`](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sip-trunking#origination) for incoming calls to your communications infrastructure from the PSTN.|
|answered_by|string \| null|false|none|Either `human` or `machine` if this call was initiated with answering machine detection. Empty otherwise.|
|api_version|string \| null|false|none|The API version used to create the call.|
|forwarded_from|string \| null|false|none|The forwarding phone number if this call was an incoming call forwarded from another number (depends on carrier supporting forwarding). Otherwise, empty.|
|group_sid|string \| null|false|none|The Group SID associated with this call. If no Group is associated with the call, the field is empty.|
|caller_name|string \| null|false|none|The caller's name if this call was an incoming call to a phone number with caller ID Lookup enabled. Otherwise, empty.|
|queue_time|string \| null|false|none|The wait time in milliseconds before the call is placed.|
|trunk_sid|string \| null|false|none|The unique identifier of the trunk resource that was used for this call. The field is empty if the call was not made using a SIP trunk or if the call is not terminated.|
|uri|string \| null|false|none|The URI of this resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.|
|subresource_uris|object(uri-map) \| null|false|none|A list of subresources available to this call, identified by their URIs relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.|
